headline: High food and petrol prices paint bleak picture of state of the nation — Small-Ferguson - Jamaica Observer
summary: Opposition Senator Ramon Small-Ferguson told the Senate's State of the Nation Debate that high food and petrol prices are squeezing households and small businesses. He said pressure on household budgets is growing.
why: Jamaica is a small Caribbean island economy that depends heavily on imported fuel and food, so global commodity prices feed directly into domestic living costs.
